acceptanceCriteria: Lock hold time measured before and after at 13k receipts.
A concurrent-writer test shows head movement forces a safe retry with no lost or duplicated receipt.
body:
Idea (V1-0645 lane): do the observation outside the writer lock and only recheck the head under the lock, retrying on movement. Related: V1-0850 (checkpoint retention under lock). Target lock hold about 0.1 s versus about 0.4 s.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: Optimistic observe outside the writer lock with a head recheck to cut lease lock hold from about 0.4 s to about 0.1 s
